skill.name: full-stack-orchestration-full-stack-feature
skill.description: Coordinate full-stack feature delivery across architecture, backend, frontend, testing, security, deployment, and operations.
skill.summary: Orchestrates API-first full-stack feature development from design through production rollout.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: I adjudicated all seven static findings as false positives. The flagged backticks are markdown inline-code formatting for a filename and configuration option names, not Ruby or shell execution. No evidence of prompt injection or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks mark a markdown file path, not Ruby or shell execution. The instruction only tells the model to open a local resource if examples are needed.
The backticks format the configuration key stack in markdown prose. There is no executable command context or interpolation sink.
The backticks format the configuration key deployment_target in markdown prose. The line describes user input, not a shell command.
The backticks format the configuration key feature_flags in markdown prose. No code path executes this value.
The backticks format the configuration key api_style in markdown prose. The content only lists REST or GraphQL as options.
The backticks format the configuration key testing_depth in markdown prose. There is no shell, Ruby, or command execution behavior.
The backticks format the configuration key compliance in markdown prose. The line describes compliance options and does not execute commands.

content.value_statement: Full-stack features often fail when teams plan each layer separately. This skill coordinates API-first design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
actual_capabilities: Guides database schema, backend service, and frontend component architecture planning.
Coordinates backend, frontend, database, testing, security, deployment, observability, and performance work.
Provides prompts for specialized subagents across implementation phases.
Defines expected outputs for architecture, code, tests, infrastructure, and monitoring.
Lists configuration options for stack, deployment target, API style, testing depth, and compliance.
limitations: It is an orchestration guide, not an executable implementation tool.
It depends on available subagents and project-specific context.
It does not verify generated code or infrastructure by itself.
It references an optional playbook file that is not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product Feature
use_cases.description: Create a phased plan that connects database design, API contracts, frontend components, and release work.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Parallel Implementation
use_cases.description: Split a full-stack build into backend, frontend, database, and test work with clear expected outputs.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Production Rollout
use_cases.description: Align CI/CD, feature flags, monitoring, security review, and performance validation before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Feature Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a full-stack feature for [feature]. Stack: [stack]. Show phases, required inputs, and expected outputs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a single feature.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate API-First Build
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to coordinate an API-first implementation for [feature]. Include database design, API contracts, frontend integration, and contract tests.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate coordination across backend and frontend teams.

prompt_templates.title: Add Security and Compliance
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan security hardening for [feature]. Compliance needs: [requirements]. Include audit scope, tests, and remediation outputs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for regulated or sensitive features.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Production Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to prepare production rollout for [feature]. Target: [deployment_target]. Include CI/CD, observability, feature flags, rollback, and performance checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced launch planning across engineering and operations.

output_examples.input: Plan a React and FastAPI billing feature with PostgreSQL.
output: A phased architecture and implementation plan.
Expected outputs for database, backend, frontend, testing, security, and deployment.
Configuration notes for stack, API style, rollout, and compliance.

output_examples.input: Prepare a production release checklist for a GraphQL analytics dashboard.
output: A release plan covering contract tests, end-to-end tests, monitoring, and rollback.
Security audit tasks for authentication, authorization, input validation, and secrets handling.
Performance and observability checkpoints for launch readiness.

best_practices: Start with API contracts before backend and frontend implementation.
Keep expected outputs for each phase visible and traceable.
Validate the final feature with contract, integration, security, and rollout checks.
anti_patterns: Starting frontend and backend work without agreed API contracts.
Skipping security, observability, or rollback planning until after launch.
Treating generated plans as verified implementation evidence.

faq.question: What does this skill help coordinate?
faq.answer: It coordinates full-stack feature work across architecture, implementation, testing, security, deployment, and operations.

faq.question: Does it write the final application code?
faq.answer: No. It provides orchestration prompts and expected outputs for specialized implementation work.

faq.question: Which stacks does it support?
faq.answer: It is stack-neutral and includes configuration options for frameworks, API style, deployment target, and compliance needs.

faq.question: Can it support regulated projects?
faq.answer: Yes, it includes compliance configuration and security audit planning, but users must verify all requirements.

faq.question: Does it require specialized subagents?
faq.answer: It is designed around specialized subagents. Results depend on which agents are available in the user environment.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The reviewed content is guidance-only markdown. It does not contain executable commands or network calls.
